title: got banned by the penguin

replies.author: Myworld6
replies.body:
Hey SEM,

Your ban was handled horribly. It was intended to be a 1 day temp ban but due to the minor changes to the banning command it was carried out incorrectly. For that, I apologise.

However, the temp ban was deserved as you had been previously threatening players, saying "I know your address" and threatening to attack him. After being kicked, you then posted that suggestive message, which for all intents and purposes was another threat. Thus, this appeal is denied. If you have any questions or objections, please post them below. I shall leave this thread open for 24 hours.

Kind regards,
Myworld.
